setup: Headless ot_emu (octabam f7d72906, the adapted emulator), MKI panel, --dsp --dsp-rt, stopped transport; the Modwerk beta base 0.7.5 built from the developer's own 1.40C with the package installed over the emulated USB; a project created on an empty Set, arrangements 1-3 of book 1 named SONG ALPHA, BRAVO and CHARLIE through the emulator's memory poke; the LCD as the panel link carries it (module_draw included), 128x64 at integer scale 6.
captureMethod: A private ot_emu session (--interactive --usb-host): npm run device -- try <package> --accept --emulator, panel keys as key rows, the screen rebuilt from UART A's transmit bytes with octabam's tools/panel/panel_link.py (capture-module-ui.py reads stock's LCD plane, which misses module_draw).
plan: ARR > CHANGE on book 1, arrangement 3 chosen; RIGHT to book 2; LEFT back to book 1.

screenshots.shows: ARR > CHANGE after returning to book 1: BOOK 1 at the top right, the list redrawn with book 1's names, arrangement 3 chosen with the cursor on it.
